name: ha-notify
description: Sends Claude Code events to your phone through Home Assistant: when Claude finishes a turn, needs a permission, or is waiting for you. Includes a per-project mute you can set from the prompt.

webhook_url.title: Home Assistant webhook URL
webhook_url.description: The full webhook URL, for example https://homeassistant.local:8123/api/webhook/your-webhook-id . Home Assistant webhooks have no login, so the webhook ID is effectively a password - treat this URL as a secret. CLAUDE_NOTIFY_URL overrides it per project.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Only needed if your Home Assistant uses a certificate from an internal CA. Passed to curl as --cacert. Overridden by CLAUDE_NOTIFY_CACERT.

insecure_tls.title: Skip certificate checks
insecure_tls.description: Sends with curl -k, which disables certificate checking entirely. Prefer the CA certificate option above. Overridden by CLAUDE_NOTIFY_INSECURE=1.
